## Core Focus & Competencies
- Python Backend Engineering: Flask, FastAPI, WebSockets, Socket.IO, session state architectures.
- Campus & Mobile Systems: EduPortal campus OS (PWA and TWA packaging for Android).
- Browser Automation & Scraping: Selenium, headless Chromium DOM automation, session rotation, captcha handling.
- Computer Vision & Edge: OpenCV, image preprocessing, document parsing pipelines.
- Database & Data Ingestion: SQLite relational modeling, streaming Excel/CSV-to-SQLite loaders.

## Primary Systems & Projects
- EduPortal: Campus operating system / student portal for DDU Gorakhpur, integrating attendance, results, notices, syllabus, and administrative workflows.
- Local-Messaging-App: LAN-based real-time socket communication system with zero external internet dependencies.
- Road-Maintenance-System: Civic infrastructure complaint management with role-based routing and status tracking.
- Automated Result Scraper: Resilient university scraping engine handling session state, dynamic DOM, and rate limits.
- Excel-to-SQLite: Streaming data migration pipeline transforming messy tabular spreadsheets into structured, normalized relational databases.
